kinds.source_description: A reconstruction at one Micronesian level with its reflexes; its members include reconstructions at lower levels (Proto-Chuukic under Proto-Micronesian) and comparanda outside Micronesian (Proto-Oceanic, Proto-Polynesian, Fijian, Dempwolff's Uraustronesisch).
kinds.note: Links compiled by the nested rule: each form descends from the form of its set at the lowest level above it, on the MCD's tree extended in etc/tree.json.
A hedge on the set's assertion.

kinds.source_description: Boolean flag on a form's membership.
kinds.wety_kind: certainty on a membership link: possible
kinds.note: A hedge on the member and on its compiled link.

kinds.source_description: 'Cf.' groups listed after a cognate set: forms of interest beside it, candidates for membership excluded by some irregularity (Bender et al. 2003, as described in the CLDF paper).
kinds.label: cf.
kinds.note: Endorsed at possible, member by member, beside the set it names (of_set); no unnamed ancestor.

kinds.source_description: Groups of forms the MCD takes to be loans; Description gives its reasoning and sometimes the donor.
kinds.wety_kind: borrowing; the group's origin is shared
kinds.note: Members are the borrowings naming the group; the description is kept as the source's words.

kinds.source_description: A form borrowed, in a loan group; Source_Form_ID is empty in every row.
kinds.note: The group's description may name the donor; not read yet.
